intent: Root-provided signal store for toast notifications (auto-dismiss after ~5s, max 5 visible). Public API: ToastStore.toasts: Signal<Toast[]>; ToastStore.show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string; ToastStore.dismiss(id: string): void; ToastStore.clear(): void. Imports Toast/ToastSeverity from core/models/toast.model.
